requirementCoverage.title: Lobby discovery and matching
requirementCoverage.body: Players can browse discoverable open lobbies or use quick match to join an available lobby for this game. Any player in a room can share its room code or deep link to invite others; a deep link bypasses lobby browsing. Joining as a player requires an available slot under the configured capacity. An invited player who reaches a full room can choose observer mode. Before the game start countdown begins, if a player leaves a full room, the oldest observer is promoted into the final player position and the remaining players move up to close the vacancy. If player/observer membership or readiness has not changed for 30 seconds before countdown, all players are prompted once for that room version to mark ready; any such change resets the interval. When all but one player have marked ready, the holdout receives a five-second warning. If they mark ready before it expires, the countdown begins immediately. If the warning expires while the holdout remains unready in a room with more than two players, they are removed and the countdown begins. In an exactly two-player lobby, the holdout remains and the lobby waits without starting the countdown until both players are ready. The roster locks when the countdown begins, and a player who leaves afterward is not replaced. Rooms are private by default; the creator may enable discoverability. Quick match selects the oldest eligible room, breaking equal creation times by stable room ID. These joins use the same atomic capacity check.

requirementCoverage.title: Lobby
requirementCoverage.body: The room view displays the room code, configured maximum capacity, available player slots, current players, and observers separately. A game cannot start with fewer than 2 players. Any player in the room can invite others by sharing its code or deep link. The room identifies the anchor player. Before the game start countdown begins, when a player leaves a full room, the oldest observer is promoted into the final player position and the remaining players move up to close the vacancy. If the lobby aggregate has no membership or readiness change for 30 seconds before the start countdown, all players are prompted once for that unchanged state version to mark themselves ready; any membership or readiness change resets the idle interval. When all but one player have marked ready, the holdout receives a five-second warning to mark ready. If they mark ready before it expires, the countdown begins immediately. If the warning expires in a lobby of more than two players and the holdout remains unready, they are removed and the countdown begins with the remaining roster locked. In an exactly two-player lobby, the holdout remains and the lobby waits without starting the countdown until both players are ready. The roster locks when the countdown begins; a player who leaves afterward is not replaced. The room creator has no special readiness or start authority; every player has the same lobby controls. Rooms are private by default; the creator may enable discovery. Quick match selects the oldest eligible room with a free seat and uses stable room ID to break ties. A 10-second countdown begins when all active players are ready. If a player leaves after countdown begins, nobody replaces them. If fewer than two original players remain when the countdown expires, the game is aborted and the room closes.
